assumptions.funding_spread_pct: MVP assumption: +1.5 percentage points for funding/liquidity above KEY_RATE; not Alfa-Bank internal transfer pricing
assumptions.operating_cost_pct: MVP assumption: 2 percentage points annually on exposure; not a measured product expense ratio
assumptions.required_margin_pct: MVP assumption: 3 percentage points of required annual residual return; capital remuneration is not separately calibrated
assumptions.lgd_pct: MVP conservative assumption: 45%; external reference for senior unsecured non-financial corporates is 40%, plus an explicit 5 percentage point uncertainty buffer. Not a calibrated Russian SME or IP loss estimate
assumptions.product_differences: Common baseline for all three unsecured products; no unsupported product-specific calibration
assumptions.expiry: Explicit MVP review deadline before the next scheduled CBR meeting on 2026-12-18; not an assertion that KEY_RATE changes on that date
